ColonyCouncil.DecreeDef.label: long hours
ColonyCouncil.DecreeDef.description: Everyone works harder and longer until the decree ends. Faster building, harvesting and crafting, paid for in mood. Hard workers take it in stride; the lazy take it personally.

effects.li: Most colonists resent it; the industrious don't mind.

cheerful.li: Let's get it all done! Everything! Today!

plain.li: My back already hurts and we haven't started.

blunt.li: I'll work longer. I won't work happier.

gloomy.li: We'll work ourselves into the graves we've been digging.

warm.li: I'll do it. But please don't make this a habit.

ColonyCouncil.DecreeDef.label: rationing
ColonyCouncil.DecreeDef.description: Smaller portions for everyone. The stores last a good deal longer, and stomachs grumble. Ascetics hardly notice; gourmands suffer.

effects.li: Everyone gets hungry 25% more slowly, so food lasts longer.
Everyone except ascetics minds; gourmands and the greedy hate it.

plain.li: Better hungry now than starving in winter.

gloomy.li: I'm always hungry anyway. Now it's official.

plain.li: Half a bowl. I'm supposed to work all day on half a bowl.
I can hear my stomach from across the room.

blunt.li: Cut my food and see how fast I work.

cheerful.li: Smaller meals! Well, more chewing per bite, I suppose!

warm.li: Give my share to the children. I'll manage.

ColonyCouncil.DecreeDef.label: drills
ColonyCouncil.DecreeDef.description: Daily weapons drills for everyone who can fight. Shooting and melee improve steadily, other work slows, and most people find it exhausting. The bloodthirsty love it.

effects.li: Everyone who can fight practices shooting and melee every waking hour.
The bloodthirsty, tough and brawlers enjoy it; the wimpy and the kind hate it.

plain.li: Next raid, they'll find us ready.

blunt.li: About time somebody taught you lot which end goes bang.

cheerful.li: Target practice! I'm going to name the targets!

plain.li: I came here to farm, not to march.

warm.li: I don't want to get good at this. I really don't.

cold.li: Training a cook to shoot is an inefficient use of a cook.

ColonyCouncil.DecreeDef.label: study hours
ColonyCouncil.DecreeDef.description: Evenings of lessons and reading for everyone. Skills improve faster and research picks up, at the cost of some work and patience. Thinkers love it; brawlers count the minutes.

effects.li: Everyone learns 30% faster and researches 20% faster.
Those with a passion for intellectual work like it; brawlers hate it.

plain.li: I've been waiting years for someone to make everyone read.

cheerful.li: School! For grown-ups! I'll bring the chalk!

cold.li: Skills compound. This is an investment.

plain.li: I didn't survive a crash landing to sit through lectures.

gloomy.li: Learning things just means knowing exactly how we'll die.

ColonyCouncil.DecreeDef.label: austerity
ColonyCouncil.DecreeDef.description: The council takes no new wishes, and everyone is asked to make do. Standards come back down to earth, which makes everyone easier to please afterwards. Ascetics are delighted; the greedy are not.

effects.li: No new wishes while it lasts.
Everyone's standards drop quickly, so the council's rewards count for more again.
Ascetics love it; the greedy and jealous hate it.

plain.li: We've been living soft. A little hardship never killed anyone. Well. Rarely.

cold.li: Expectations had become unsustainable. This corrects them.

warm.li: We have each other. That's enough for a while.

plain.li: So we're not allowed to want things now.

gloomy.li: I knew the good times wouldn't last. I didn't think we'd cancel them on purpose.

ColonyCouncil.DecreeDef.label: festival days
ColonyCouncil.DecreeDef.description: A few days of rest, music and late nights. Moods lift and work slows to a crawl. Good for a colony on the edge; standards rise afterwards, so don't make it a habit.

effects.li: Everyone's mood lifts; the lazy are overjoyed.

plain.li: Nobody touch a shovel for three days. That's an order.

cheerful.li: FESTIVAL! I've been practicing my dancing! Badly, but practicing!

gloomy.li: Fine. One last good week before whatever comes next.

cold.li: Three days of lost output. I hope the mood is worth it.
